summary: v34 fixes verified end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest pass (10 test_pricing + 13 test_cost_estimate incl. 3 new v34 consistency tests). Added assertions: (a) cost == sum(per_model_credits) with default rate, (b) same holds across credits_per_usd = 250/500/1000, (c) zero-credit user hitting POST /api/conversations/{id}/message returns 402 whose detail.required equals /api/cost/estimate cost which equals sum(per_model_credits). Frontend: live modal displays TOP=252 credits and per-model rows summing exactly to 252 (150+74+17+10+1), no 'API calls' row, no 'Estimated OpenRouter cost' row, no '$' anywhere, per-model lines show only 'N credits'. Cancel closes the modal, Modify configuration navigates to Settings view (Council models / Chairman / Advanced tabs visible).
critical_code_review_comments: pricing._PRICING_CACHE_TS is still only refreshed on HTTP 200; on OpenRouter downtime every request incurs a fresh 20s timeout. Set timestamp on failure (with shorter TTL) to avoid latency spikes (carried over from iter30).
pricing.usd_to_credits() is unused now that estimate_run_credits computes per-model credits inline; consider removing or documenting.
estimate_run_credits still returns 'estimated_usd' in the response even though the UI no longer displays it — harmless but slightly dead-weight over the wire.

On a 4-model council with default credits_per_usd=500 the standard-request cost is ~252 credits (150+74+17+10+1).
